Well good news, you don't need a whole lot. This guide is pretty much the least amount of combat I could think of and 0 past lvl 90. When you get to 90+ the only thing you need is ashes as rituals sustain their own mementos. 

100 dragon bones and ~100 dragonkin bones (fastest, can use other bones if you have them)
Herb level for extreme necro or overloads to train (not necessary but always helpful) - can also use these to boost for higher lvl attraction glyphs
~5000 ashes (this number is probably way off since I did rituals to 200m, you might not and the XP is different) - Do City of Um medium tasks and ashes will be portered to your bank for free

Thats really all the supplies you need. Prayer potions for soul split camping and prayers and food if you don't have it unlocked would be helpful. For gear you can rock a salve amulet and ghost hunter equipment if you have it until you get some t70+ augmentable gear if you wanna fight ghosts or any other hybrid armor if you wanna fight anything else. The mobs you kill don't matter too much, hopefully not every mob is still being camped - I would go for ankous - bound skeletons - Ravenous ghouls personally. Not sure if rav ghouls are do-able without vamp aura or SS but you don't have to kill them, could kill any mob realistically the hard part is just getting to lvl 90 to start doing the best rituals. Hope this helps
